title: Inbox Zero
description_en: Open-source Superhuman alternative. Inbox Zero Mail is an open-source email client for Gmail and Outlook. Fast, keyboard-first, and free to use, on web, Mac, Windows and iPhone, with all your accounts in one inbox. Add AI for $20/mo: every email is sorted, and replies are drafted in your voice before you open them. Comment privately with your team, get Slack alerts, and give the AI context from your tools.
description_zh: Inbox Zero是一个开源的AI邮件客户端，对标Superhuman但价格更低。核心功能包括：①多账户统一收件箱(Gmail+Outlook) ②键盘优先的快速操作界面 ③AI自动邮件分类和预写回复(学习用户语气) ④团队私密评论和Slack集成 ⑤跨平台支持(Web/Mac/Windows/iPhone)。基础版免费开源，AI功能$20/月订阅。产品解决的核心痛点是邮件过载和重复性回复工作，通过AI在用户打开邮件前就完成分类和草稿准备，显著提升处理效率。Product Hunt获352票和4.79高评分证明产品市场契合度强，开源策略带来GitHub 13k+ stars的社区认可。

full_profile.biz_model_zh: 采用Freemium模式：基础邮件客户端功能完全免费开源，AI增强功能收费$20/月(对比Superhuman的$30/月有价格优势)。收费逻辑是AI分类、自动回复草稿、工具集成等高价值功能为知识工作者节省大量时间，愿意为效率付费。开源策略降低获客成本，通过社区口碑传播转化付费用户。与Superhuman等闭源竞品的差异在于：①价格更低 ②代码透明可自部署 ③社区驱动迭代快。潜在风险是免费用户转化率和AI功能的边际成本控制。

title: Figma Specs
description_en: A container for your context that lives on the Figma canvas. Figma Specs is a collaborative Markdown document that can live on its own or beside your designs. Embed Figma frames and FigJam diagrams, work through comments with teammates and agents, and pass the full context to coding agents through MCP.

title: Popcraft

OAuth sign-in, no API key. 100 free credits.
